rules.name: legacy-rov-01-mysql
rules.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE, TABLE_ROWS AS row_estimate, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_TIME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbsystemuat' AND RIGHT(TABLE_NAME, 4) = '_rov' ORDER BY TABLE_ROWS DESC, TABLE_NAME

SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_rov' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_rov UNION ALL SELECT 'security_info_table_rov', COUNT(*) FROM dbsystemuat.security_info_table_rov
SELECT tablename, valuation_date, status_type, status, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM dbsystemuat.status_table WHERE RIGHT(tablename, 4) = '_rov' ORDER BY updated_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
